name: Santa Maria Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Fog, wind and the Pacific keep days cool here, so the grapes keep plenty of acidity.
Pinot Noir and Chardonnay lead, with a good share of Syrah.
Its Pinot Noir has darker cherry fruit, balanced by savory notes such as earthy spice and tea.
Chardonnay is lean, with bright acidity, green apple and chalk in the west, and fuller, with yellow apple, in the east.

blurb.text: A south Central Coast AVA straddling Santa Barbara and San Luis Obispo counties, the nation's third AVA. Its east-west valley lets cool Pacific wind and fog flow in, giving a mild climate and a longer growing season.
